definitions.gloss: guide map; information map; directory map
definitions.explanation: A map displayed at a location to help visitors find their way around. Commonly found at stations, parks, shopping centers, tourist spots, and large buildings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{案内図|あんないず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a guide map in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {案内図|あんないず}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{現在地|げんざいち}→現在地：27733_genzaichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked my current location on the guide map.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{案内図|あんないず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦コース→コース：10864_koosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I looked at the guide map at the park entrance and decided on a walking route.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (guidance, information) + ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (map, diagram). Refers to the kind of map that is posted at a location to orient visitors, not a portable map you carry. Extremely common in Japan at train stations, parks, shopping malls, and tourist sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {案内図|あんないず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at a guide map)
- ⟦{館内|かんない}→館内：22088_kannai⟧{案内図|あんないず} (building directory/floor map)
- ⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧{案内図|あんないず} (area guide map)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧: map — a general portable map, not limited to on-site information boards
- ⟦{見取|みと}り{図|ず}→見取り図：14836_mitorizu⟧: floor plan, layout — shows the internal layout of a building
